dataset: PSLM / HIES (Pakistan Social & Living Standards Measurement Survey)
access: Free microdata on written request to PBS; some rounds on World Bank Microdata Library
notes: Workhorse for district panels. CAUTION: the 2010-11 wave is easy to drop silently; district codes change with new district creation.

dataset: Household Integrated Economic Survey (consumption module)
district_id: Province-rep; district only in PSLM-linked rounds
notes: Only source of full consumption aggregates and poverty lines.

dataset: Labour Force Survey
coverage: 1990-91 to 2020-21 (annual), quarterly rounds in some years
notes: Best source for employment status, sector, hours, wages, informality.

dataset: National Nutrition Survey
producer: Ministry of NHSR&C / Aga Khan University / UNICEF
notes: Rare district-representative anthropometry. Single cross-section; use as endline or for cross-sectional heterogeneity.

dataset: Punjab Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS)
notes: The single best district panel for health/education/WASH in Punjab. 5-6 waves = usable event study.

dataset: Sindh MICS
notes: Fewer waves than Punjab; still supports 2x2 and staggered DiD.

dataset: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa MICS
notes: 2019 round includes the ex-FATA merged districts - crucial for merger studies.

dataset: Balochistan MICS
notes: Sparse coverage; use with caution for panels.

dataset: Pakistan Demographic and Health Survey
district_id: Province-representative; cluster GPS available under request
notes: Use GPS clusters + district shapefiles to build district aggregates (noisy; low cluster counts).

dataset: Population & Housing Census
access: District tables free; microdata restricted / IPUMS for older rounds
notes: Use for baseline covariates, denominators, and pre-period balance.

dataset: ASER Pakistan (Annual Status of Education Report)
notes: THE district panel for learning outcomes (reading/arithmetic). 15 waves - ideal for staggered event studies of education programmes.

dataset: Pakistan Education Statistics / NEMIS
notes: Enrolment, teachers, facilities by district and level. Watch for definitional breaks after 2016.

dataset: Punjab School Information System / Annual School Census (PSIS)
access: Partly public via Punjab Open Data / on request
notes: School-level panel with GPS. Very strong for within-district and event-study designs.

dataset: Provincial EMIS (SEMIS Sindh, EMIS KP, BEMIS Balochistan)
notes: Quality varies; KP IMU data are unusually good post-2014.

dataset: District Health Information System (DHIS2)
access: On request from provincial DGHS / DHIS cell
notes: Monthly facility utilisation, immunisation, ANC, deliveries. Best high-frequency health outcome source.

dataset: EPI / Polio surveillance (NEOC-EOC, LQAS, SIA data)
producer: National / Provincial Emergency Operations Centres, WHO
access: Partly public; detailed data on request from EOC/WHO
notes: Campaign-round panels at district-UC level; useful outcome and treatment.

dataset: Banking Statistics of Pakistan / district-wise credit & deposits
notes: Deposits, advances, number of branches by district. Also SBP agricultural credit disbursement by district and bank.

dataset: Branchless Banking Newsletter / Payment Systems Review
unit: Agent / transaction aggregates, some district splits
notes: Use for mobile money and agent network expansion.

dataset: MicroWatch (microfinance outreach)
notes: Quarterly district-level active borrowers, gross loan portfolio, branches. Excellent for credit-access outcomes.

dataset: Election Commission of Pakistan results & electoral rolls
coverage: 1988-2024 general and local elections; rolls updated continuously
notes: Turnout, vote shares, candidate entry, female registered voters (a strong proxy for female CNIC documentation).

dataset: Global Terrorism Database
notes: Standard terrorism panel. Coverage break in 2012 (data-collection change) - control for it.

dataset: BFRS Political Violence in Pakistan Dataset
producer: Bueno de Mesquita, Fair, Jordan, Rais & Shapiro (ESOC, Princeton)
notes: Best-coded district-level violence panel for the pre-2012 period. Complements GTD.

dataset: ACLED Pakistan
producer: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project
notes: Includes protests and riots, not just terrorism - useful for social-unrest outcomes.

dataset: PIPS Pakistan Security Reports
notes: Independent count to cross-validate GTD/BFRS.

dataset: Nighttime lights (DMSP-OLS harmonised + VIIRS)
producer: NOAA / Colorado School of Mines EOG; Li et al. harmonised series
notes: Proxy for local economic activity at high frequency. Good for programmes with no survey coverage.

dataset: Relative Wealth Index
producer: Meta Data for Good (Chi, Fang, Chatterjee & Blumenstock 2022)
notes: Cross-section only - use for heterogeneity, not for DiD.

dataset: WorldPop gridded population & age-sex structure
notes: Denominators for rate outcomes when census years are far apart.

dataset: MODIS / Sentinel-2 vegetation, land cover and cropland products
notes: NDVI/EVI for agricultural productivity; land-cover change for cropping intensity.

dataset: CHIRPS rainfall + ERA5 temperature reanalysis
notes: Essential time-varying controls; also an instrument/shock in agriculture designs.

dataset: Flood inundation products (Sentinel-1 SAR, MODIS MOD09, UNOSAT, Copernicus EMS, DFO)
notes: Continuous treatment intensity for flood DiD designs.

dataset: Agricultural Census & Mouza Census
notes: Mouza Census gives village-level facility access (school, BHU, road, electricity) - excellent pre-period controls.

dataset: Crop Reporting Service district crop area & yield
notes: Annual district yields for wheat, rice, cotton, sugarcane, maize.

dataset: Agriculture Marketing Information Service (mandi prices)
notes: Daily wholesale prices - high-frequency market-integration outcomes.

dataset: Sensitive Price Indicator & monthly retail prices
notes: City-level, not full district coverage - match cities to districts.

dataset: Punjab Land Records Authority MIS (fard, mutations, ARC transactions)
access: Restricted; via formal request or RTI to PLRA/BOR
notes: Universe of registered land transactions - the outcome for land-digitisation studies.

dataset: Board of Revenue land revenue & registration statistics
notes: Stamp duty and registration fee collections - fiscal capacity outcomes.

dataset: PITB dashboards & Punjab Open Data Portal
notes: Citizen Feedback Monitoring Programme, e-Khidmat Markaz, PSRMS, school & health monitoring app data.

dataset: Provincial police crime statistics (CRO) and FIR records
access: Aggregates public; FIR microdata via request/RTI
notes: Reported crime is itself endogenous to reporting cost - interpret with care.

dataset: Judicial statistics (Law & Justice Commission, LHC/High Court MIS)
producer: Law & Justice Commission of Pakistan; provincial High Courts
notes: Case institution and disposal by district - dispute and enforcement outcomes.

dataset: FBR tax collection, active taxpayer list & tax directory
district_id: RTO region, needs mapping to districts
notes: Formalisation and fiscal outcomes; coarse geography is the main limitation.

dataset: Census of Manufacturing Industries & Economic Census
notes: Firm-level outcomes; long gaps between rounds.

dataset: Electoral rolls / CNIC registration by district
notes: Female registered voters per 100 males is a widely used proxy for women's documentation.

dataset: Mobile network coverage polygons (Mobile Coverage Explorer / OpenCellID)
notes: Constructs district-year mobile broadband coverage for telecom rollout designs.

dataset: Ookla Open Data (fixed & mobile performance)
notes: Post-2019 only; good for internet-quality outcomes.

dataset: Universal Service Fund project contracts & coverage
producer: Universal Service Fund Co., Ministry of IT
unit: Project lot (district / tehsil), with award and completion dates
notes: One of the cleanest documented staggered rollouts in Pakistan - dates and lots are published.

dataset: Punjab Skills Development Fund MIS & tracer surveys
access: Reports public; microdata via research agreement
notes: Trainee-level records plus randomised and quasi-experimental evaluations.

dataset: Humanitarian Data Exchange - Pakistan (boundaries, damage, IDPs)
notes: Use the OCHA admin2 shapefile as the spine; keep a crosswalk for split districts.

dataset: PDMA/NDMA disaster damage & needs assessments
producer: National / Provincial Disaster Management Authorities, World Bank PDNA
notes: Deaths, damaged houses, affected population by district.

dataset: Pakistan Multidimensional Poverty Index & district poverty maps
notes: Ready-made district deprivation series for pre-trend checks and heterogeneity.

dataset: Pakistan National Human Development Report district HDI
notes: Baseline development ranking - a standard covariate for heterogeneous effects.

dataset: Pakistan Panel Household Survey
notes: The only genuine long household panel; only ~19 districts.

dataset: World Bank Microdata Library (Pakistan)
notes: Hosts many BISP, PSLM and impact-evaluation baseline/endline datasets.

dataset: BISP / NSER Management Information System
unit: Household (CNIC), with district and PMT score
access: Restricted; research access via BISP or World Bank agreement
notes: Gives exact enrolment and first-payment dates by district - the treatment-timing source for all BISP-family programmes.

dataset: Sehat Sahulat Programme MIS / SLIC claims data
producer: Ministry of NHSR&C, provincial health departments, State Life Insurance Corp.
notes: Enrolment and hospitalisation claims; also the source for district activation dates.

dataset: OpenStreetMap road network and points of interest
notes: Road density and facility geolocation; coverage improves sharply after 2015.
